DashboardSub: Every cloud account is its own drive letter. Content lives in the cloud; only a bounded RAM buffer is used locally.
NoDisksYet: No virtual disks yet. Add a cloud account under Cloud Accounts.
UnlimitedShown: shown as used + 1 PB (provider reports no limit)
DisksSub: Each disk is a real Windows volume (WinFsp) backed directly by one cloud account.
ChangeLetterPrompt: New drive letter for {0} (currently {1}:). Open files are committed first.
RenamePrompt: Disk name shown in File Explorer (max 32 characters):
DisconnectConfirm: Unmount {0} ({1}:)? Pending files are uploaded first. The account stays saved and can be reconnected.
RemoveConfirm: Remove {0} and drive {1}:? Sign-in data is deleted and access is revoked. Files in the cloud are NOT deleted.
Name: Name
AccountsSub: Google Drive accounts sign in through Google's own page in your browser. Each account gets its own drive.
NeedOAuthClient: Google sign-in needs an OAuth client (Client ID and secret) from your Google Cloud project. Set it up in Settings → Google sign-in; the setup guide walks you through it.
BrowserSignInInfo: Your browser will open Google's sign-in page. Choose the account and allow access. XCloudSSD never sees your password.
SignInCancelled: Sign-in was cancelled or timed out.
TeraBoxUnavailable: TeraBox's official API (TeraBox Open Platform) is available to partners on request. Its endpoint documentation is not public, and XCloudSSD does not use unofficial endpoints or read browser cookies. Until Open Platform credentials are available, TeraBox drives cannot be mounted.
FilesSub: Browse and manage files on your virtual disks. Every action goes through the drive itself, straight to the cloud.
FilterHint: Filter this folder, or search the whole account with “Search cloud”
DeleteConfirm: Delete {0} item(s)? Depending on Settings they go to the provider's trash or are deleted permanently.
GamesSub: Use a virtual disk as a Steam library or game folder.
GamesHonestBody: Game files are read straight from the cloud into RAM, so loading speed depends on your connection and the provider's rate limits. Google Drive cannot change part of a file: new files written in order stream fine, but launchers that write large files out of order (Steam downloads often do) may run out of the RAM write buffer and fail with a clear error instead of using your SSD. Use “Run storage check” and test one game before moving a big library. The Xbox app needs NTFS-only features and is not supported.
SteamNotFound: Steam is not installed for this Windows user.
LibraryNotRegistered: Library {0} exists but is not registered in Steam yet.
SteamLibraryCreated: Created {0}. In Steam open Settings → Storage → Add Drive and choose this folder.
SteamAddDriveSteps: In Steam: Settings → Storage → drive list → Add Drive → pick your XCloudSSD drive (or its SteamLibrary folder).
GamesFolderCreated: Created {0}. Choose this folder as the install location in Epic Games Launcher, EA app or Ubisoft Connect.
TransfersSub: Uploads are only marked Completed after the cloud confirmed the data and size/MD5 matched.
PerfSub: Live values measured by the service from real requests and filesystem calls.
SettingsSub: Service settings apply to every disk. Appearance settings are per Windows user.
TemplateExported: Template written to {0}. Translate the values, rename the file (e.g. fr.json) and reopen Settings.
NotificationsHint: Show a tray notification when an upload fails or goes offline
GoogleClientHelp: Google requires every app to use its own OAuth client. Create a “Desktop app” client in your Google Cloud project (guide below), then import its JSON file. The secret is stored encrypted by the service and never shown again.
ClientJsonInvalid: This is not a Google OAuth client JSON file.
OptKeepMounted: Keep virtual disks mounted while offline
OptRestoreConfig: Restore previous configuration (drive letters and connected disks)
OptStartApp: Start the XCloudSSD window in the tray when I sign in
DriveLetterHint: Drive letters are set per disk under My Virtual Disks.
OptRamBufferHint: Shared by read buffers and unsaved writes. No disk cache is ever used.
OptReportNtfsHint: Report NTFS (improves compatibility with Steam and launchers)
DiagnosticsSaved: Saved to {0}. It contains logs and status only — no tokens or file contents.
BannerServiceStopped: XCloudSSDService is not running, so no virtual disks are mounted.
BannerNoWinFsp: WinFsp is not installed. It is required to mount virtual disks; reinstall XCloudSSD or install WinFsp.
BannerNoOAuth: Google sign-in is not set up yet. Add your OAuth client in Settings to connect Google Drive accounts.
TrayExit: Exit (disks stay mounted by the service)
